notes.title: Orogenesis: Advent of Rust is out now!
notes.content:

Simply update Orogenesis and do the "Enzo Ending", and the update will begin.

Enjoy!

-Samu

notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
Bug fixes yet again-

-Water Dungeon Collision fixes

-Invisible Dude in Pipe's House fixes

-Shantytown Collision fixes

Yeet~

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
More bug fixes.

-Ninfugus now purchasable from the Alchemist in Shantytown

-Edna's quest-line bugs fixed- unfortunately this will only work on new characters created, so those already with bugged saves are unfortunately already too late.

-Cleric quest-line bugs fixed, but same situation with Edna.

-Collisions fixed in areas reported to have collision errors.

Thanks again! Please report more bugs if you've found them!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes, y'all.

-Dialogue and Typos fixed.

-Areas reported to be able to walk through walls fixed.

-Marriage with Liz fixed.

Hope you all are enjoying so far, please report bugs!
